title: Epic and Google propose a settlement that would have Google share its Play Store app catalog with rivals and offer a registered app store program for Android (Leah Nylen/Bloomberg)
summary: Leah Nylen / Bloomberg: Epic and Google propose a settlement that would have Google share its Play Store app catalog with rivals and offer a registered app store program for Android — Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Epic Games Inc. proposed a new settlement Wednesday to resolve a long-running antitrust case between the two companies.
